articles.title: GSB Drives Data & AI Culture at “GSB Data & AI Culture Showcase 2026” to Boost Services
articles.description: Mr. Songpol Chevapanyaroj, President and CEO of Government Savings Bank (GSB), presided over the opening of the “GSB Data & AI Culture Showcase 2026” under the theme “Turn Insights into Impact,” aimed at equipping personnel at all levels with the knowledge and skills to use data and AI technologies with awareness, safety, and responsibility. The event featured discussion panels with executives, experts, and teams applying data and AI in practice, alongside innovation showcases from the bank and partner organizations across more than 27 booths. The bank aims to foster a data-driven decision-making work culture and leverage technology to enhance operational efficiency and service quality to meet customer needs, aligning with the GSB Way of Work in driving the organization toward becoming a Data & AI Driven Organization. The event was recently held at GSB Phiphat Building, GSB Head Office.

articles.title: CiDi Unveils Expanded Heavy-Duty Embodied AI Portfolio at bauma CHINA 2026, Extending Automation from Surface Mining to Underground Operations
articles.description: **media[1324269]**New product portfolio including autonomous freight truck, cabless electric mining truck, mining agent, underground drilling robot and V2X solutions showcase CiDi's expanding capabilities across heavy-duty industrial applicationsCiDi unveils an expanded portfolio of autonomous vehicles, mining robots and intelligent systems at bauma CHINA 2026, extending automation from open-pit mining to public-road freight transportation and underground operations.New products include VEGA, a purpose-built L4 autonomous heavy-duty truck; CDK155, a 100-tonne cabless electric autonomous mining truck; Yura, the first mining agent in the world; and CT17-1S, an underground drilling robot designed to remove people from hazardous working environments; and its V2X solution for real-time coordination among vehicles, infrastructure and personnel in open-pit mines.Powered by Gravicortex, CiDi's proprietary heavy-duty embodied AI platform, its three business pillars-Autonomous Driving, Task Robotics, and Intelligent Hardware & Services-share technology capabilities and operational data to support integrated, scalable automation.CiDi's MetaMine platform has served nearly 40 mines globally, with more than 1,000 pieces of equipment connected simultaneously during peak periods.
